title: RankedTiers
body:
🔥 **RankedTiers.net — EU & NA** 🔥
*Where skill meets chaos.*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💎 **About Us**
Looking for fast-paced, competitive **Crystal PvP** with smooth performance?
Our server brings together **EU & NA players** with low-latency nodes, fair fights, and an active community.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚔️ **Features**
• ⚡ Optimized for **Crystal PvP (1.20+)**
• 🌍 **Dual Regions** (EU + NA nodes)
• 🧠 Skill-based matchmaking & ranked modes
• 🛡️ Anti-cheat tuned for PvP accuracy
• 🎯 Practice arenas & duel system
• 💬 Active Discord & friendly community

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎉 **Events (Weekly!)**
• 🏆 Crystal PvP Tournaments
• 💰 Cash / Rank Rewards
• 🔥 FFA Showdowns
• 👑 King of the Hill battles
• 🎁 Surprise drop events

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🚀 **Why Join?**
No pay-to-win. No lag excuses. Just pure skill.
Whether you're grinding ranked or dominating events — this is where top players compete.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📡 **Join Now**
IP: `(na.)rankedtiers.net`
Discord: `discord.gg/Rankedtiers`

💥 *Sharpen your aim. Place your crystals. Dominate the fight.* 💥
